text:
Eden: Quick thread to lock the benchmark narrative for next week's webinar. Need a single hero claim, 3 micro-charts, and two CTAs for inbound. Keep everything snappy.

Marco: Proposed hero: "Latency you can promise. Unit costs you can measure." Subtitle: "Three charts that map config -> latency & $/1k tokens."

Jules: Chart sketch: 1) ridge/violin plot: median/p95/p99 by model + deploy mode (hosted/dedicated/private), 2) cost waterfall: base model cost, infra, then opt savings (batch, quant, cache), 3) persona table: recommended config + expected p95 and $/1k.

Priya: Data slices request: model, deploy_mode, quant, seq_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_hit_rate, batch_profile. Prompt mix: 50/35/15 short/med/long.

Eden: Timeline: Priya hero + alt lines by Wed 11am. Marco charts CSV by Wed 4pm. Jules mockups by Thu AM. I'll assemble Friday for review.

Priya: Hero alternates: 
- A: "Promise performance. Know the cost."
- B: "Predictable latency. Measurable savings."
Prefer B for slides.

Marco: Data export path (will populate): s3://bench-exports/2026/marketing/5203332222.csv. ChartBot will validate.

BenchBot: Preview schema check OK. Required headers present. Note: fill missing cache_hit_rate with 0.

Jules: Visuals: use muted brand colors, highlight optimizations in accent color, micro-annotations for cache impact (e.g. "cache hit -> ~40% lower $/token"). Keep captions <= 10 words.

Marco: Repro snippet for notes:
```
# rough 1k token cost calc
sec_per_1k = 0.82
gpu_rate = 2.75  # $/gpu-hour
cost = (sec_per_1k / 3600) * gpu_rate
print(cost)
```

Eden: We'll include a small anonymized case: "Customer X moved to Dedicated + batching: p95 down 220ms, $/1k down 38%" — Nora/PMs will approve anonymization.

Priya: Two CTAs for the 1-pager: "Run your prompts — see your numbers" and "Request a Dedicated eval." Social blurb: "Fast median. Tamer tail. Lower bills."

Jules: I'll design a compact appendix slide with kernel/quant notes for folks who want depth.

Marco: Uploaded sample prompts & CSV preview: https://internal.redwood/bench/preview/5203332222 (internal).

BenchBot: Upload timestamp 2026-03-23T09:40:00Z. Mean cache_hit_rate in preview = 0.37.

Eden: Great. Final check-in Thu 5pm. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
